The trend is 11 → 1 → 4 with 12 of 16 findings resolved and all 16 in-diff; the four open ones are all P2 and all sit on the D0 surface, which by the diff takes no destructive action, writes only gitignored receipts, and is read by nothing on the merge path (pr-ready.mjs, guard.sh and guard-decision.mjs are untouched in a 17-file/2015-line patch), so none reaches the destructive / receipt-corrupting / authority-widening bar. commentsSincePass filters only `>= passAt`, so the later-pass race the record explicitly supports can put round N+1's comments in round N's brief — the wrong-account class this record exists to refuse.

Settled Decision 10 rules out per-finding reconciliation and refusal on an omission, but not a non-empty document, and 'agrees' printed over no account at all is the favourable-answer rule the page renderer already states.
